data.one_liner: Defines system tray icons and menus for Flutter desktop apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux to display an icon in the system tray with tooltips, titles, and context menus. It supports handling click events, multiple tray icons, and native menu items.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for Windows, macOS, or Linux.
Your desktop app needs a system tray icon with a context menu or event handling.
avoid_when: You are building a mobile or web-only application.
You do not require desktop tray integration.
strengths: Supports multiple tray icons simultaneously via the native API.
Provides cross-platform desktop support for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Includes a legacy bridge for easy migration from 0.5.x versions.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific development dependencies on Linux (GTK 3, X11, Xi).
Linux system tray features heavily depend on the desktop environment's panel/extension support (e.g., GNOME needs AppIndicator).
data.setup_notes: Linux build machines require GTK 3, X11, and Xi development files (e.g., libgtk-3-dev, libx11-dev, libxi-dev).
